title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Weber author record with literal repair stream through Volume II sections 176-194
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page keeps Weber material together by author: original-language modern LaTeX reader PDFs, current English translation drafts, literal repair supplements, and source/artifact files.

Status at a glance.

  • Original-language modern LaTeX readers: [##--------] Lehrbuch der Algebra Volumes I and III are front-facing here.
  • Older cumulative English draft: [######----] Volume II remains available through section 194 as a broad working translation/paraphrase draft; it is being replaced by a literal repair stream rather than treated as final.
  • Literal repair stream: [#---------] Volume II sections 176-194 now have paired German literal-source and English literal-translation readers; next continuation point is section 195.
  • Source/artifact preservation: [##########] available TeX, component PDFs, source pages, repair notes, and provenance are in 80 Weber - TeX Sources, Component PDFs, and Provenance.zip.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working drafts for checking, not certified critical editions.

The organization is by author and work. Readers can use the older cumulative draft for breadth while the literal repair stream incrementally supplies source-checkable German/English pairs.
notes: Public author record. The older Volume II cumulative English reader remains available as a broad working draft; the literal repair stream now covers Volume II sections 176-194 and includes source pages plus render checks in the artifact ZIP.
